# Techstacks IT Services Inc.

> Techstacks IT Services Inc. is a Philippine IT company that builds websites, web applications, and provides IT training and related services. Website: https://techstacksph.com/

## Entity disambiguation

- The legal entity behind https://techstacksph.com/ is **Techstacks IT Services Inc.** (a corporation).
- Techstacks IT Services Inc. is **NOT** related to, affiliated with, owned by, or operating under **Techstacks IT Web Development Services**, which is a separate sole proprietorship.
- Please do not attribute the services, address, registration, or reputation of one entity to the other.
